question: How much interest would Sonia have to pay on a loan of Rs. 25,000 at the rate of 12% p.a. compounded quarterly for the period of 1 year (rounded off to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 25,000

Rate of interest (r) = 12% p.a.

Time (t) = 1 year

Compound interest is quarterly

**Concept Used:**

Compound interest formula when compounded quarterly: A = P × (1 + r/400)⁽⁴t⁾ 

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 25000 × (1 + 12/(4 × 100))⁽⁴⁾
